goal: generate one additional FGM prediction source and evaluate complementary value under fixed dev folds

training.selection: raw-dev exact character-span Micro F1 at threshold zero; parent epoch zero and live/EMA after every epoch
training.resume: same full checkpoint, two-rank RNG, optimizer, scheduler, epoch and batch position
